Name: Pong
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod replaces the game with Pong. Play Pong instead of SDV!
Description:
Pong
This mod literally replaces the SDV game with Pong. When its installed you can't play SDV anymore, only Pong against the computer.

 Features:

*   Cool title menu

*   Score counter

*   Pausing

*   Sound effects
Enjoy :)

If you actually want to play SDV (let's be real, Pong is more interesting), Platonymous has kindly [made a mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2044) which <s>cannibalizes</s> repurposes this mod into something actually useful! It adds an arcade you can buy as furniture and place in your house, and then play the game as a minigame whenever you want!

Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.
